summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Borr Drilling Ltd reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting. The filing lists the re-election of eight directors, re-appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers as independent auditors, director fee approval, and presentation of annual financial statements. No special situation—such as M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, restructuring, or delisting—is disclosed. The document is a standard corporate governance update with no event-driven implications.
